statusText: Tail eases to 20%. Mapped policy state: WATCH. The 31,196.75 session low has held for more than an hour while NQ Dec26 recovered to 31,276.50 at 08:20Z, -0.40%, narrowing from -0.51%. The repeated-extension amplifier has lapsed, but Brent at 104.13, +3.92%, and a long end near 24-year highs keep Tail at the bottom of the WATCH band ahead of the US cash open.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is WATCH with Tail at 20%, the floor of the 20-24% band and below the 25% blocking threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers 12:30Z-15:00Z, spanning the jobless-claims print and the US cash open, where conditional Tail peaks at 22%. Conditional Tail enters the EA_ON band from 09:00Z and again from 15:00Z onward if intraday retracements of normal depth persist.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold the session low and recover as the extension stalls, while crude above 104 and a 24-year-high long end keep conditions difficult
body:
The ninth Globex hour of the Oct 7-8 session has stabilised the decline rather than extended it. NQ Dec26 traded 31,276.50 as of 08:20Z, -125.75 or -0.40% against a 31,402.25 prior close, after readings of 31,261.00 at 08:16Z and 31,264.00 on an independent feed at 08:15Z, so both direction and the recovery are confirmed across sources. The decisive observation is that the 31,196.75 session low set in the previous hour has held for more than an hour and price has recovered 79.75 points off it, roughly 0.26%, while the decline has narrowed from -0.51% at 07:17Z. Price now sits about 30% of the way up a 31,196.75-31,466.00 band worth 269.25 points or 0.86%, against the lower fifth an hour ago. That matters because the specific amplifier behind the previous hour's 22% Tail was repeated extension after failed retracements. A sustained recovery that holds the low for a full hour is a retracement of normal depth, which is the opposite of the shallow-pullback structure the risk contract treats as pathological. Today's futures low also sits above the 31,143.00 Oct 7 low, so the session has not broken the prior day's floor. Tail therefore eases from 22% to 20%, the floor of the WATCH band, and the dominant mode moves from trend-down to mixed because the path is no longer one-way.

Tail eases rather than falling to the EA_ON band because the cross-asset backdrop has not stabilised and in places has deteriorated within the hour. Brent trades 104.13, +3.93 or +3.92%, inside a 100.75-104.38 range, having accelerated from 103.81 and +3.60% an hour earlier and from the +2.1% and 102.30 level reported in the Reuters Asian wrap. The driver is verified supply risk rather than demand: UK authorities have recorded at least nine Strait of Hormuz attacks in October amid the continuing US-Iran conflict, and Houthi strikes on Saudi airports revived supply concerns. The long end is the second channel and is also moving: the 10-year is 5.323%, up 4.5 basis points, after a 24-year high of 5.36% on Oct 7 that a strong auction pulled back; the 30-year is 5.706%, up 4.5 basis points, against a 5.64% H.15 fix for Oct 6; and the 2-year is 4.795%. September Fed minutes showed most members expecting another hike by year-end, with roughly 19% priced for October and about 80% for December. Asian cash closed broadly weaker than the earlier wrap had indicated, with the Kospi -2.62%, the Hang Seng -1.63%, the Shanghai Composite -0.79% and the Nikkei -1.13%, and Samsung slipped despite a record profit forecast. The dollar index at 102.22 sits near an 18-month peak.

The counterweights keep this a WATCH at the band floor rather than a block. The absolute magnitude is small: a 0.40% decline inside a 0.86% session band is an orderly grind, not violent directional repricing. VIX is now available live at 15.60, up 0.52 or 3.45% from a 15.08 close, which registers the risk-off tone without indicating a volatility regime shift. Cash NDX closed Oct 7 at 31,160.08, -0.21%, after a 30,904.46 low that was fully retraced into the close, the recent precedent for mean reversion still functioning in this regime. Oil, yields and event importance remain Stress and Confidence inputs under the standing contract until observed NQ structure establishes mean-reversion failure, so Stress rises to 59% while Tail declines. The 12:30Z jobless-claims print and the 13:30Z cash open are the next genuine structural checkpoints and have not yet occurred; the 08:30Z Waller remarks began shortly before this assessment and no verified market-moving content is available. Confidence is 87%: triple-sourced NQ quotes through 08:20Z, a live VIX, current crude and yield levels, a verified seven-day calendar and dual-sourced Asian closes support it, while an H.15 fix only through Oct 6, a calendar feed whose actual-value columns were misaligned and therefore unusable for release outcomes, and unavailable shared Finviz context are the gaps. The shared Finviz evidence file was collected 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z with partial status, about nine days beyond the 90-minute freshness contract, so it was excluded and this assessment rests entirely on independent research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 10-14% through the Asian and European hours of Oct 7, rose into a 20-23% WATCH band between 11:00Z and 15:00Z as a trend-down phase developed into the US cash open, then decayed steadily once the cash dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into the close. Every hour from 16:00Z through 05:00Z held the 10-18% EA_ON band with Stress at 47-53%. The last two lookback hours mark the current episode: Tail lifted to 14% at 06:00Z as the 05:16Z retracement failed, then to 22% at 07:00Z after a second failed retracement set a 31,196.75 low. That low has since held, which is the development this assessment prices.
outlookSummary: Base case is that the stabilisation observed in the current hour extends into two-way rotation through European and US cash trade, while firmer crude above 104, a long end near 24-year highs, a dollar index at an 18-month peak and broadly lower Asian closes remain the dominant background conflict. Conditional Tail enters the EA_ON band at 19% from 09:00Z through 11:00Z, then peaks at 22% across the 12:30Z claims print and the 13:30Z US cash open, which is the published danger window. It returns to the EA_ON band from 15:00Z and settles at 14-16% through the overnight Globex and Asian hours. The 17:00Z 30-year auction is the day's most specific long-end transmission checkpoint. Confidence declines from 87% to 75% across the horizon because no current evidence constrains the later slots.
